description: Successfully completed the 1-Month Intensive National Training Program in Cybersecurity organized by IPCIH Youth & Peace Society. Participated actively in the program and developed essential cybersecurity knowledge and practical skills within the Cybersecurity & Digital Defense track.
Completed practical training across Linux administration, networking, Docker, security principles, access control, firewalls, IDS, malware analysis and web vulnerability testing.
Conducted penetration testing and vulnerability assessments in simulated attack environments, identifying weaknesses and recommending improvements.
